europe_now.title: Nationwide Protests and Strikes Erupt Across France
europe_now.summary: French labor unions and citizens staged massive nationwide strikes and protests over the high cost of living and the state of public services, drawing hundreds of thousands of demonstrators.

sources.headline: French protests: 'It's only when public, private sector act together that you can make changes'
French protests see numbers surge as unions join strikes over high cost of living

top_stories.title: Serbian Judicial Investigations
top_stories.summary: Following recent political developments and elections, Serbia's judicial system has initiated a series of long-stalled investigations and arrests. This post-election activity marks a significant shift in addressing unresolved legal cases in the country.

sources.headline: After the landslide victory of the Students' List, Serbia's judiciary springs into life after years of stalled and unresolved cases and investigations
Arrests and investigations as Serbia begins post-election clean-up

top_stories.title: EU Court Ruling on CBD Edibles
top_stories.summary: The European Union court has officially ruled that CBD edibles cannot carry organic product labels. The legal decision clarifies regulatory standards for cannabis-derived consumer goods sold throughout member states.
